Tess: Final RN draft uploaded: https://docs.internal/rn/infer-v2.10. Target deploy 2025-04-22 16:00 UTC. Need ops + comms signoff.
Liam: Quick check — are we pinning the model tag for the canary?
Tess: Yes, pin inference:v2.10-canary for 6h at 5% traffic. Auto-promote to v2.10.0 if canary passes.
Anika: Proposing rollback triggers: sustained 5xx >=3% over 10m OR p95 latency >2.0s for 3 consecutive 5m buckets. Also manual rollback if eval set shows quality regressions.
Liam: Fine. Who's rollback owner? I can take first 4h.
Marco: I'll own the second shift. Add both names in RN with handoff procedure.
Tess: Rollback command to include in RN ops snippet:
```
infractl rollback --service=inference --to-tag=v2.9.30 --reason "canary_failure"
```
deploybot: Scheduled deploy: 2025-04-22T16:00:00Z. Canary: 5% for 6h. Fallback target: v2.9.30.
Anika: Add telemetry tag rn=infer-v2.10-canary and post-deploy eval prompts link. Internal announce at T-10m; customer notify at T+3h only on success. Embargo until canary complete.
Liam: I suggest exact rollback thresholds in RN sentence form so PMs understand. Also include the oncall escalation flow.
Tess: Good point. I'll update PM blurb: "No user-facing changes; expect performance improvements on long responses (~6-9%)."
Marco: I'll paste minimal post-rollback verification steps into the runbook and RN after deploy.
Anika: LGTM. Anyone object to internal preflight T-10m?
Liam: No objections. I'll watch dashboards.
Tess: Sending internal preflight in 8m and pinning this thread for RN archive. :white_check_mark:
